en-US.name: Stickman Video Director
en-US.summary: Optional local MIT package of the stickman video director skill, with scripts, fonts, licenses, style boards and catalogs. B-mode soundtrack audio, B6 style-lock reference videos, the B6 paint kit and the approved B8 reference/replay packs are not shipped; fetch them on demand from pin-fixed URLs with SHA-256 checks. The fetch script is never run automatically and does not execute downloads. Node.js 20+ and the declared npm packages are required for the local Code Engine renderer.
en-US.description: Market-local packaging of kaomei/stickman-video-director@10287822ba47579321068da1b93801face9160dd path skills/directing-stickman-videos, with the repository-root MIT LICENSE copied into the installed content directory. Package version 2026.11.24. On-demand asset groups and exclusion reasons are recorded in UPSTREAM.md and references/fetch-manifest.json.

zh-CN.name: 火柴人视频导演
zh-CN.summary: 火柴人视频导演技能的可选 MIT 本地包，收录脚本、字体、许可证、风格样板和目录。B 模式配乐音频、B6 风格锁定参考视频、B6 绘制底板，以及已批准的 B8 参考/回放包不随包分发；需按固定 URL 与 SHA-256 清单按需下载。下载脚本不会自动运行，也不会执行下载的文件。本地代码引擎渲染器需要 Node.js 20+ 和已声明的 npm 依赖。
zh-CN.description: 基于 kaomei/stickman-video-director@10287822ba47579321068da1b93801face9160dd 路径 skills/directing-stickman-videos 的市场本地包装，并把仓库根目录 MIT LICENSE 放入安装内容目录。包版本 2026.11.24。按需资源分组与排除理由见 UPSTREAM.md 和 references/fetch-manifest.json。

requirements.value: Node.js 20+ and the declared npm packages in package.json (@napi-rs/canvas, sharp) for the local Code Engine renderer. These binaries are not bundled.
Some B-mode helper scripts need Python 3 and, for B8, packages listed in scripts/requirements-b8.txt.

B-mode soundtrack audio, B6 style-lock videos, the B6 paint kit and approved B8 references are fetched only by an explicit run of scripts/fetch-optional-assets.py against pin-fixed URLs and SHA-256 hashes. Install does not run this script or execute downloads.
No paid API is bundled. Do not auto-run untrusted remote code.
